title: One-Health respiratory-environment memory modeling: data and reproducibility release
description: Clean aggregated publication-level data and reproducibility outputs for a regional One-Health respiratory-environment memory modeling study, including historical 2019–2024 analyses and supplemental external 2025 M0–M2 validation.
notes: M3 external validation remains deferred until GRD 2025 is available. Update authors, repository URL, related identifiers, license, and manuscript metadata before deposition.
